Sending DDP Datagrams

To send a DDP datagram to another socket, you must first open a socket with the POpenSktfunction, prepare a write-data structure, and finally send the packet using the PWriteDDP function described in this section. You can use the BuildDDPwds procedure described in this section to create the write-data structure.
